Typed cookie consent translations for Inth banners, dialogs, and preference centers, in 53 languages.

## Key Features

- 53 languages, including all 24 official EU languages
- Typed translation objects, so a misspelled key fails type checking
- Override one string or a whole language
- Language follows the visitor's browser, or a language that you set

## Documentation

See the [documentation](https://inth.com/docs/customization/translations) for guides, API reference, and examples.

## Security

Do not open a public issue for a security vulnerability. Report it privately through [GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/inthhq/inth/security/advisories/new). We examine every valid report.

- Do not share the vulnerability in public forums, issues, or pull requests
- Give the steps to reproduce it and the versions it affects
- Give us time to release a fix before you disclose it
